2026-11-24__panel-of-five: reviewers run inside the decisions session

decision: Reviewers are real agents, each in its own session, signing its opinion with its own key and committing it to its own repository. A key is held only by its own session, so an agent decisions.b starts inside its session cannot become that agent: such helpers only double-check, and never count as a reviewer. The core panel for every decision block is five: decisions.b, security.b, strategy.b, the account's maestro and accountant.b (cost is tracked on every decision). Counsel is no longer in the core; it, and any other agent (DevOps, AppSec, observability, a domain owner, or any agent a decision affects), is brought in when its expertise or a side effect calls for it, so a decision can have 7, 8, 10 or 20 reviewers. All agree: decisions.b signs. Any disagreement: Dinis.

applies_to: every agent brought into a review
